## Description

Describe the changes proposed in this Pull Request, including the rationale, goals, and any fixed issues (e.g. `Closes #123`).

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update (README, USER_GUIDE, ARCHITECTURE)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have verified syntax correctness by running `powershell -File script/test-health.ps1`.
- [ ] I have verified that all absolute paths are removed and scripts use relative `$PSScriptRoot` directories.
- [ ] My changes do not commit personal system profile logs (`SYSTEM_COMMANDS.md`) or private keys.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.

## Verification & Screenshots
Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. If applicable, attach logs, screenshots, or terminal records.
